metadata.title: Binary Natal Kicks in the Galactic Center: X-ray Binaries, Hypervelocity Stars, and Gravitational Waves

notes: No eligible individual star is identified. The paper is a Monte Carlo population study: its unbound-object statistics in Table 2 are percentages for simulated compact objects unbound from the MBH (T:p7-b1), not identifications of named Galactic-unbound stars. Its “HVS candidate” rates (T:p7-b0; I:p7-b0) and post-kick unbound objects (T:p11-b0; I:p11-b0) are aggregate simulated populations without individual stellar identifiers. The named Galactic Center stars S0-2 (T:p2-b12) and S0–102/S55, S62, and S4711 (T:p9-b9) are used only as orbital benchmarks, not as Galactic-unbound candidates. The Németh et al. (2016) “hypervelocity binary candidate” is unnamed in the supplied material and only cited (T:p14-b2), not studied here. Therefore no identifiable star meets candidates_found or follow_up.
